Island guide

Choose a map pin to play. Each first visit adds a stamp to your island passport.

Switch between Grown-up and Little Me on your player card. Each keeps her own outfit and accessories.

Match cards, deliver a bouquet, or photograph a style challenge to earn stars. Collect 10 stars to unlock the golden postcard frame.

Use a mouse, touch, or Tab and Enter. Your looks, stars, and scrapbook save in this browser.
